name: Keiro

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: HTTP API only; no required vendor Python SDK.

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: `results[]` include title, URL, snippet, score, and optional published date.

content.comment: `/api/v2/search/content` returns full page markdown (`full_text`) and optional chunks.

mode.comment: v2 Search `mode`: `light`→fast, `ai`→balanced, `deep`→deep. anysearch uses `/api/v2/search/flash` for fast mode, `/api/v2/keiro` by default, and `/api/v2/search/content` for full-text content.

pricing_per_1k.value: Conflicting official pricing: Keiro lite from $0.10 / 1K; browserfoundry $0.25 / 1K
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

free_tier_limits.value: Conflict: Keiro 750 credits/month; browserfoundry 1,250; free/paid conversion differs
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: Flash: 0.312s p50 / 1.1s p99; indexed: 0.487s p50; balanced/deep: not published
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Provider-run May 2026 benchmark of 1,000 agent queries. No independent rerun or latency distribution for Keiro's balanced and deep paths was found.

notes: SDK maps default v2 search to `/api/v2/keiro`, `mode=fast` to `/api/v2/search/flash`, and `include_content=true` to `/api/v2/search/content`.

native_api.value: Rebranded browserfoundry; claims existing keys/endpoints continue. Fast proxy-backed search; Content, Answer and Agentic are separate. Do not assume paid credit conversion for free tier.

rate_limits.value: Conflict: 15 vs 30 RPM; paid starts $29.99 vs $30

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
